title: Horizontal Database Sharding & Partitioning
learningObjectives: Select partition keys to balance write loads and avoid hot spots
Compare range-based, hash-based, and directory-based sharding architectures
Handle cross-shard queries and distributed transactions
keyTradeoffs: Application-level sharding vs transparent distributed database engines (Citrus, Vitess)
Co-locating related entity tables vs uniform horizontal data distribution
commonPitfalls: Choosing a monotonically increasing ID as partition key (causing single-shard write bottleneck)
Executing unindexed scatter-gather queries across all database shards
transferPrompt: When should a team choose read replicas over sharding for scaling database read bottlenecks?
